FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Research
Associate to work on various NDDS level drug delivery systems for clinical
applications in the IPCA foundation industrial project sanctioned to undersigned.
Shortlisted candidates will be called for a interview through telephone/email in
the office of Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh
ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:
 M. Pharm/M.S. (Pharmaceutics/Industrial Pharmacy or any other
equivalent discipline).
 Minimum of 55% marks at Graduate and Master’s levels both (50% in case
of SC/ST/PH)
 Qualified in GPAT, GATE, UGC-NET or PU PhD entrance exam.
Desirable:
Minimum 5 year experience of industrial Research project.
Fellowship:
 Monthly emoluments of Rs. 75,000/- p.m., in accordance to the experience
& expertise.
Sd/- Sd/-
Professor O P Katare
Principal Investigator
Prof Anil Kumar
Chairperson, UIPS
Scanned copies of all the educational degrees, experience and Curriculum vitae is
to be send by post or email at dropkatareuips@gmail.com should reach the
undersigned latest by January 24, 2025..
